hunks.baseline: Of course, he would have sent me off on the road to the underworld.
hunks.sol: Of course, he wouldn’t have sent me home. He’d have sent me down the road to the underworld.

hunks.baseline: It was the day the Jin Family of Taiyuan would rise as the undisputed ruler of Shanxi Province. How could the youngest son of the family show up late?
hunks.sol: It was the day the Jin Family of Taiyuan would rise as the ruler of Shanxi Province. How could the family’s youngest show up late?

hunks.baseline: Not that I had much to pack. I had one travel bundle, and that was it.
hunks.sol: Not that I had much to pack. One travel bundle, and that was it.

hunks.baseline: Their flushed faces and the wine jar beside them were proof that they had already been drinking heavily since morning.
hunks.sol: Their flushed faces and the wine jar beside them were proof that they had already been drinking heavily this early in the day.

hunks.baseline: One was a huge old man whose body was larger than that of most strapping young men. The other had such a small, frail frame that a breath might have blown him away.
hunks.sol: One was a huge old man whose body was larger than that of most grown men. The other had such a small, frail frame that a breath might have blown him away.

hunks.baseline: “I’d rather avoid that.”
hunks.sol: “That’s a bit…”

hunks.baseline: “Hewe! It’s delishush! Try shome!”
hunks.sol: “Here! It’s delishush! Try shome!”

hunks.baseline: “Thanksh, I will!”
hunks.sol: “Mm—I’ll eat lotsh too!”

hunks.baseline: The fact that someone like him was a Peak master was proof that reality was unfair. I couldn’t contain my anguish over the future of the Murim.
hunks.sol: The fact that a guy like him was a Peak master—I couldn’t help but lament how unfair reality was.

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo spoke to me.
hunks.sol: As I fretted over the future of the Murim, Jang Taebo spoke to me.

hunks.baseline: “A grand feast always attracts all sorts of riffraff. Shanxi Province may be a frontier region, but this is the seat where one becomes the hegemon of an entire province. I may not be a martial artist, but I have enough worldly experience to know. Just wait and see. Ah, and…”
hunks.sol: “A grand feast always attracts all sorts of riffraff. Shanxi Province may be a frontier region, but this is the seat where one becomes the hegemon of a whole province. I may not be a martial artist, but I have enough worldly experience to know. Just wait and see. Ah, and…”

hunks.baseline: Even the neighborhood laundromat charged a fee for repairs. Jang Taebo was a master artisan renowned throughout the world. He might not have been as skilled as he was in his prime, but I didn’t believe his abilities had vanished over the past ten years.
hunks.sol: Even the neighborhood laundry charged a fee for repairs. Jang Taebo was a master artisan renowned throughout the world. He might not have been as skilled as he was in his prime, but I didn’t believe his abilities had vanished over the past ten years.

hunks.baseline: Jang Taebo chuckled when he saw my expression.
hunks.sol: Jang Taebo let out a short laugh when he saw my expression.

hunks.baseline: What a shining example, this Jang Taebo. Every blacksmith under heaven should follow his example and Taebo accordingly.
hunks.sol: Truly a shining Taebo. Every blacksmith under heaven should follow his example and Taebo accordingly.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t as though the innkeeper were a modern man who had brought in an electric heater…
hunks.sol: It wasn’t as if the innkeeper was from the modern world and had set up an electric heater…

hunks.baseline: “I thought you were a fellow with nothing but shit in your head, but you do have some fairly plausible thoughts after all.”
hunks.sol: “I thought you were a fellow with nothing but shit in his head, but you do have some fairly plausible thoughts after all.”

hunks.baseline: “Where is the treasured jade?”
hunks.sol: “Where is the Treasured Jade?”

hunks.baseline: “The treasured jade. The jade.”
hunks.sol: “The Treasured Jade, I said. The Treasured Jade.”

hunks.baseline: The jade? A treasure, a gemstone—something like that?
hunks.sol: The Treasured Jade? As in a treasure, a gemstone—something like that?

hunks.baseline: But since I had never even known the jade existed, I could only stare at him in bewilderment.
hunks.sol: But since I had never even known the Treasured Jade existed, I could only stare at him in bewilderment.

hunks.baseline: The reason Jeok Cheongang had returned to the world was probably not only to find his Disciple. He also wanted to recover the treasures of the Fire Gate Clan that had been scattered because of him.
hunks.sol: The reason Jeok Cheongang had returned to the world was probably not only to find his Disciple. He also wanted to recover the treasures of the Fire Gate Clan that had leaked out in the aftermath.

hunks.baseline: The jade he was talking about seemed to be one of them.
hunks.sol: The Treasured Jade he spoke of seemed to be one of them.

hunks.baseline: It was a treasure that even the Fire King was willing to endure the trouble of searching for at all costs.
hunks.sol: It was a treasure that even the Fire King—of all people—had to find at all costs, nuisance or not.

hunks.baseline: Just as a creeping sense of danger began to outweigh my curiosity about what the jade actually was, Jeok Cheongang spoke.
hunks.sol: Just as a creeping sense of danger began to outweigh my curiosity about what the Treasured Jade actually was, Jeok Cheongang spoke.

hunks.baseline: After exchanging a silent glance of farewell with Jang Taebo, Jeok Cheongang turned away and tossed out one meaningful remark.
hunks.sol: After exchanging a silent nod of farewell with Jang Taebo, Jeok Cheongang turned away and tossed out one meaningful remark.
